name: rfq-system
description: RFQ & Cost Estimation System for forging part manufacturers

scripts.dev: npm run dev:api & npm run dev:web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=@rfq/api && npm run build --workspace=@rfq/web
scripts.db:reset: prisma migrate reset --force --schema=prisma/schema.prisma && npm run prisma:seed
